map.周边离焦信号量计算器 使用指南: Peripheral Defocus Signal Amount Calculator User Guide
map.输入镜片设计与佩戴参数，计算相对周边离焦量 RPD，评估近视防控镜片（离焦框架镜: Enter the lens design and wearing parameters to compute the relative peripheral defocus RPD and assess the strength and direction (myopic or hyperopic) of the defocus signal from myopia-control lenses (defocus spectacle lenses and OK lenses). Used to evaluate optical solutions.
map.相对周边离焦 RPD = 周边屈光度 − 中央屈光度（D）: Relative peripheral defocus RPD = peripheral refraction - central refraction (D)
map.RPD>0 为近视性离焦，RPD<0 为远视性离焦；结合镜片类型评估近视防控效能: RPD > 0 is myopic defocus and RPD < 0 is hyperopic defocus; assess myopia-control effectiveness together with the lens type.
map.算中心与周边屈光差（RPD）判离焦类型。: Compute the center-to-periphery refraction difference (RPD) to determine the defocus type.
map.周边近视离焦延缓眼轴。: Peripheral myopic defocus slows axial elongation.
map.：中心 −3.00D、偏心 20° 处周边 −2.50D → 相对周边离焦 RP: Center -3.00D and periphery -2.50D at 20 degrees off-axis -> RPD = -2.50 - (-3.00) = +0.50D (relatively positive in the periphery, so myopic defocus).
map.：RPD>0（周边相对正离焦）被认为可减缓眼轴增长；普通单光片常 RPD<0（周: RPD > 0 (relatively positive defocus in the periphery) is thought to slow axial elongation; ordinary single-vision lenses often have RPD < 0 (hyperopic peripheral defocus) which promotes myopia.

map.不够。中心清但周边远视离焦会信号眼轴增长，是近年防控焦点。: Not enough. A clear center does not help if the periphery has hyperopic defocus, which signals axial elongation and has been a focus of myopia control in recent years.
